description: Source code for a TCF (Target Communication Framework) module handling TCP communication, message parsing, and event/command processing.

methods.name: mystrcat
methods.description: Concatenates s2 to s1, assuming s1 has enough space.

methods.name: message_length
methods.description: Calculates message length up to a delimiter or max length.

methods.name: start_tcf_field
methods.description: Starts a TCF field by copying the field name and appending a marker.

methods.name: append_tcf_field
methods.description: Appends a field and marker to a TCF message.

methods.name: convert_to_tcf_message
methods.description: Converts a buffer into a TCF message format, replacing field markers.

methods.name: get_next_tcf_field
methods.description: Retrieves the next field in a TCF message.

methods.name: get_next_tcf_msg
methods.description: Retrieves the next message in a buffer containing multiple TCF messages.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses a command message into a TCF_Command structure.

methods.name: parse_event
methods.description: Parses an event message into a TCF_Event structure.

methods.name: handle_FileSystemCommand
methods.description: Handles filesystem commands, returns unsupported code.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Processes incoming events and calls appropriate handlers.

methods.name: handle_command
methods.description: Processes incoming commands and sends responses.

methods.name: handle_incoming
methods.description: Main handler for incoming data buffer, processes multiple messages.

methods.name: InitTcf
methods.description: Initializes TCP socket and streams for TCF communication.
